title: 第二十二章 本小姐是大善人
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
因为没经验，所以这几个取材普通的泥人，实际上只相当于成精的泥巴化形成了人，而且其全面加载了人工智能，导致他们虽有灵智，却呆板无比。

    他闭上眼，向来自信运筹帷幄的那双眼疲惫的合上，斜飞的英挺剑眉此时微微皱起，那薄厚适中的诱人的红唇也抿着，泄露了主人不太愉悦的心情。

    而视频也暂停在老爷子的背影之上。这背影可是扛起了即将倒塌的华世，所以他的决定，只要是华世的员工，就都会接受。

    这并不是说明杨眉很牛逼，随便创个功法就能补上偏门功法的缺漏。

    人们在网上不停的冷漠着打着嘴炮，在现实里却只能做个懦弱的旁观者，依旧，打着嘴炮。

    “走啦！咱们去庆祝明天的胜利！”约翰搂着白焱的脖子高兴地说。

    突然听到门口有敲门的声音，她连忙擦了一把眼泪，不想让人看到她哭过的样子。

    陆景淮还从来没有见过她这个样子，洛青葵在他面前永远乖巧听话，这样子好像多了些活泼之气。

    这一天，又有一人被带进了祖师讲道大殿……或者不应该叫一人，而是一猴。

    关于合作事宜，乔半斤自然会联系霅溪。但是这次是地产项目，而且规模没有燕京南郊静候亭大，所以这个事情就全权由霅溪来负责了。

    沒一会儿，一行人便是下來了，夜影远远的便是看到了那一袭黑衣和熟悉的亚洲面孔，嘴角不经意的流出了笑意。
content_en:
Because of their lack of experience, these clay figurines made from ordinary materials are actually equivalent to human beings transformed from clay, and they are fully loaded with artificial intelligence, resulting in them being intelligent but extremely dull.

He closed his eyes, which were always confident and strategizing, and closed them tiredly. His slanting handsome eyebrows were slightly wrinkled at this time, and his moderately thick and attractive red lips were also pursed, revealing the master's unhappy mood.

The video also paused on the old man's back.This figure has carried the Huashi that is about to collapse, so his decision will be accepted by all employees of Huashi.

This does not mean that Yang Mei is very good and can make up for the shortcomings of partial skills by just creating a skill.

People keep talking indifferently on the Internet, but in reality they can only be cowardly bystanders, still talking.

"Let's go! Let's celebrate tomorrow's victory!" John said happily, hugging Bai Yan's neck.

Suddenly she heard a knock on the door, and she quickly wiped her tears, not wanting anyone to see her crying.

Lu Jinghuai had never seen her like this before. Luo Qingkui was always obedient and obedient in front of him, which seemed to make her more lively.

On this day, another person was brought into the Patriarch's sermon hall...or it shouldn't be called a person, but a monkey.

Regarding cooperation matters, Qiao Banjin will naturally contact Feixi.But this time it was a real estate project, and its scale was not as large as the Jinghou Pavilion in the southern suburbs of Yanjing, so Feixi was solely responsible for this matter.

After a while, a group of people came down. Ye Ying saw the black clothes and the familiar Asian face from a distance, and a smile inadvertently flowed from the corner of his mouth.
title_en: Chapter 22: This lady is a kind person
